requirements.quote: Create the directory “/home/user/docs/reports” (if it does not yet exist).
Inside that directory, create the file “config_summary.log”.
It must be plain UTF-8 text.
A block starts with a header line exactly in this form (no leading ‘./’ or absolute paths):

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
L=[l for l in open('/home/user/docs/reports/config_summary.log',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith('FILE: ')]
sys.exit(0 if L and all(l.startswith('[') and '] \u2192 ' in l for l in L) else 1)
PY

requirements.quote: Verify the exact byte-for-byte contents described above.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,os,sys
paths=sorted(glob.glob('/home/user/docs/configs/**/*.ini',recursive=True),key=os.path.basename)
blocks=[]
for p in paths:
    out=['FILE: '+os.path.basename(p)]; secs=[]
    for raw in open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines():
        s=raw.strip()
        if not s or s[0] in ';#': continue
        if s.startswith('[') and s.endswith(']'): secs.append((s[1:-1].strip(),[])); continue
        if '=' in s and secs:
            k,v=s.split('=',1); secs[-1][1].append(k.strip()+'='+v.strip())
    for n,kv in secs: out.append('['+n+'] \u2192 '+'; '.join(kv))
    blocks.append('\n'.join(out))
exp='\n\n'.join(blocks)
got=open('/home/user/docs/reports/config_summary.log',encoding='utf-8').read()
sys.exit(0 if got in (exp,exp+'\n') else 1)
PY

requirements.quote: After the last section of that file, add one blank line before the next FILE header (except after the very last file).

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
t=open('/home/user/docs/reports/config_summary.log',encoding='utf-8').read()
L=t.splitlines()
ok=not t.endswith('\n\n') and '\n\n\n' not in t and L and L[0].startswith('FILE: ')
ok=ok and all(L[i-1]=='' and (i<2 or L[i-2]!='') for i in range(1,len(L)) if L[i].startswith('FILE: '))
ok=ok and all(L[i+1].startswith('FILE: ') for i in range(len(L)-1) if L[i]=='')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
